action.summary: Compare selected KEMET C2 package dimensions with the pinned KiCad footprint geometry and identify a dimension-matched library candidate
action.command: Compare manufacturer C315C103K5R5TA drawing/specification with KiCad 10.0.6 footprint body and pad geometry
action.backend_version: KEMET C315 datasheet; KiCad 10.0.6 footprint library

checks.summary: The catalog assigns C_Disc_D3.0mm_W1.6mm_P2.50mm to C315C103K5R5TA. KEMET specifies max body dimensions 3.81 x 2.54 mm and 2.54 mm nominal lead spacing; the assigned footprint describes a 3.0 x 1.6 mm body and 2.50 mm pad pitch. C_Disc_D3.8mm_W2.6mm_P2.50mm is a better dimensional candidate, but has not been approved or validated in the full board context.

blockers.summary: Approve the proposed replacement footprint for the reference C2 component, or provide a different footprint decision.
blockers.next_action: Review the exact catalog BOM context and proposed C_Disc_D3.8mm_W2.6mm_P2.50mm footprint; confirm before any catalog/BOM mapping change.

blockers.summary: The remaining seven unique catalog MPNs have not all received this manufacturer-drawing-to-footprint geometry comparison.
blockers.next_action: Continue the mechanical audit after the C2 mismatch is dispositioned, preserving separate findings for each part.

notes: Manufacturer source: https://search.kemet.com/component-documentation/download/specsheet/C315C103K5R5TA (catalog records the source URL and existing SHA-256).
No source BOM, frozen reference design, catalog approval flag or footprint assignment was changed by this audit.
The candidate footprint has the correct nominal body envelope and a 2.50 mm pad pitch within the manufacturer lead-spacing tolerance; this dimensional comparison alone is not footprint approval.
